responseText:
**I concur with these five bounded design choices, subject to the ordering and sampling precision below.** This closes the named decisions, not HC-01–05 or runtime acceptance.

1. **The five-unit table is accepted for the exact fields, roots and permitted descendants you listed.**

   | Native UnitId | Accepted field scope |
   |---|---|
   | `TEST_ONLY.ration-pound` | Authorized portable ration/meal quantity; accepted fresh Purify food batch |
   | `prototype.potable-water.pint` | Authorized linked lot quantity; accepted fresh Purify water batch |
   | `mass-pound` | Specified extracted mining lots and selected specimen preservative |
   | `TEST_ONLY.genuine-copper-piece` | Exact tender lot after actual authorized title/custody transfer |
   | `drop-black_blood_sample` | Exact selected specimen lot |

   These are **root/profile/lineage bindings, not permission based on UnitId equality alone**. The inspected registration, specimen and sale paths support that restriction. In particular, [sale delivery transfers the exact whole portable lots](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/78dcd8632b3f7ddf2f1353bb69ec1096f9effd7f/engine/com.decennium.foundation/Laboratory/Model/SharedHavenSale.cs#L245); transaction authority does not expose buyer stock generally.

   Preserve `AvailableAmount` versus pre-cast whole `Amount`, vessel-null semantics, ItemCount and all current rights. Excluding the unlinked recipe/crop stocks from these fields does not deny their existence or remove their legacy magnitude observations. A missing required reachable binding remains a qualification defect.

2. **ExpectedObservationRevision placement is accepted, with the subsequent ordering written explicitly.**

   Keep current endpoint/seat/control, command exposure and malformed/payload checks before the new observation-freshness check. Then follow the receipt/fresh-command branches.

   Two details must remain explicit:

   - Use the **effective submission grant**, including the existing narrow Haven transaction and pre-Bishop milestone overrides. Calling `SeatCommandGrant` alone does not reproduce every legacy submission grant.
   - On a fresh request, preserve the existing host ordering of `Command.ExpectedRevision` **before** `KnownTarget`, followed by native preflight. Do not let the shorthand “KnownTarget/Core preflight” reverse those checks. [ConnectedExpeditionSession.Execute](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/78dcd8632b3f7ddf2f1353bb69ec1096f9effd7f/engine/com.decennium.foundation/Laboratory/Model/ConnectedExpeditionSession.cs#L393) establishes that order.

   An exact retry can retain its original command revision while supplying the current observation revision. It still undergoes current Core authorization before receiving successful duplicate recognition. Stale-observation denial supplies no protected target or receipt details. Legacy endpoints remain unchanged.

3. **The mining sampling is accepted as candidate generation.**

   For the stated two-category/two-unit case, each single-category selection produces three preference combinations: empty, sole failure preference, sole critical preference. The combined selection produces five. Two abilities and two hurry choices give:

   **`4 × (3 + 3 + 5) = 44 candidate requests`.**

   This is not 44 admissible options. Preferences must reference visible units belonging to that request’s selected categories. Generate them without using hidden value rankings or damaged-unit shortlists; native assessment may reject them under its existing guards. [AssessMiningCommand](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/78dcd8632b3f7ddf2f1353bb69ec1096f9effd7f/engine/com.decennium.foundation/Laboratory/Model/SharedMining.cs#L1114) makes those distinctions concrete.

   Preserve truthful assessment through the agreed safe-denial mapping, rather than presenting the generated set as a hidden eligibility shortlist. This does not approve unfinished denial mappings. Full constrained domains, native tie choices and non-enumerated combinations remain available through their defined APIs.

4. **The public portable-ID versus lot-ID treatment is accepted.**

   A physical handling target and a Purify lot target are separate identities and admissions. Neither `Id == LinkedId` nor an internal link grants public disclosure of the linked identity.

   Require the independently authorized lot target for a Purify example. Otherwise retain the operation/domain and its truthful discoverability limitation without fabricating a payload. That limitation cannot excuse an omitted binding already required and lawfully reachable within the agreed scope.

5. **The narrowed materialization boundary is accepted.**

   Conditions journals—including their complete immutable operations, origins, phases and policy identities—plus schema and exact clock supply the condition materialization inputs. Owner/policy/generation/revision and other consumer dependencies remain separately bound by the stamp and consumer contract.

   Preserve distinct journal-time and current-marker projections, including the native rule that projection does not move an already-later journal marker backward. [ConditionResolutionScope](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/78dcd8632b3f7ddf2f1353bb69ec1096f9effd7f/engine/com.decennium.foundation/Laboratory/Model/ConditionHistory.cs#L103) shows why those distinctions matter.

   Materialization remains confined to the approved owning construction/restore/transition publication boundaries. Reads consume the established projection; they cannot restore journals, traverse deadlines to rebuild it, lazily repair it or fall back to legacy projection. The finite copy audit does not establish safety of every Snapshot child or transitive consumer.

I inspected the relevant published native initializers, registration/transfer paths, host/Core admission order, mining generation/assessment, Purify targeting and condition projection sources. **I have not inspected the six unpublished local artifacts or independently reproduced their all-profile, pin-count or copy-count conclusions.** No files were changed and no builds, tests or gameplay were run.

Complete HC review, implementation qualification and final module acceptance remain open. Prior acceptances stand. The boundary remains: **finish INT-05 through actual acceptance and accepted push, then stop.**
scope: Five exact finite design choices agreed with ordering/category/current-marker precision. Targeted native source review; GPT did not inspect unpublished six complete audits. No runtime or full HC acceptance.
